test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: **"The gift of the gab" **

options.text: Talent for speaking fluently and persuasively

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Talent for speaking fluently and persuasively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The idiom **"The gift of the gab"** refers to the ability to speak fluently, easily, and persuasively. (अच्छी और प्रभावशाली बोलने की क्षमता)

 

 
• **Example:** She has the gift of the gab, which makes her an excellent salesperson.

 

 

 
• **Speaking fluently and persuasively** means the talent to convince others through articulate and coherent speech. (प्रभावी रूप से बोलने की कला)

 

 
• **Example:** A politician often needs the gift of the gab to win over the crowd.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Habit of exaggerating stories **(कहानियों को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर पेश करने की आदत): Tendency to overstate or embellish events.

 

 
• **Example:** His habit of exaggerating stories often makes it hard to believe him.

 

 

 
• **Power to make quick decisions** (जल्दी निर्णय लेने की शक्ति): The ability to decide rapidly and effectively.

 

 
• **Example:** A good leader needs the power to make quick decisions in critical situations.

 

 

 
• **Ability to cook well** (अच्छा खाना पकाने की क्षमता): Skill in preparing delicious meals.

 

 
• **Example:** Her ability to cook well has made her popular among her friends.

 

 

88:Tba8,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
